verdict.rationale: Container image scanning is a fair question for an AppSec security scanner, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents Semgrep scanning codebases and repositories: SAST, secrets, and Supply Chain SCA based on manifest parsing and repository integration. Nothing shows Semgrep scanning built container images or OS packages; repo-level dependency SCA is an adjacent capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can scan container images for OS-package and application-layer vulnerabilities before deploying them
